functions.name: emojis
functions.description: Named GitHub emoji image references. The dictionary key is the stable entry grain; aliases remain separate named entries even when they share an image URL.

metrics.name: emoji_count
metrics.comment: Named dictionary entries, including distinct aliases with shared image URLs.

functions.name: api_versions
functions.description: Supported GitHub REST API version dates from the pinned scalar date-array contract. One row per supported version; these are version labels, not release publication observations.

metrics.name: api_version_count
metrics.comment: Distinct supported REST API version labels returned by GitHub.

functions.name: api_root_observations
functions.description: GitHub root discovery URLs and URI templates as native text. Templates are descriptive values and are never followed as arbitrary request targets. Grain is one endpoint observation for the API host and current caller within an invocation; repeated invocations are snapshots, not historical records.

metrics.name: api_root_observation_count
metrics.comment: Endpoint observations retrieved for the current caller; not a count of durable GitHub resources.

functions.name: api_metadata_observations
functions.description: Typed GitHub service metadata, network range lists, SSH fingerprints and nested service domains. Returned ranges are retained exactly; they are not inferred to be exhaustive access-control policy. Grain is one endpoint observation for the API host and current caller within an invocation; repeated invocations are snapshots, not historical records.

metrics.name: api_metadata_observation_count
metrics.comment: Endpoint observations retrieved for the current caller; not a count of durable GitHub resources.

functions.name: api_rate_limit_observations
functions.description: Typed rate-limit resources and compatibility rate summary. Values depend on the current credential identity or unauthenticated egress IP; reset values are explicit Unix seconds, not fabricated observation times. Grain is one endpoint observation for the API host and current caller within an invocation; repeated invocations are snapshots, not historical records.

metrics.name: api_rate_limit_observation_count
metrics.comment: Endpoint observations retrieved for the current caller; not a count of durable GitHub resources.

api_core_requests_remaining.comment: Core requests remaining in the selected requester snapshot. Non-additive across callers or repeated invocations.

functions.name: api_zen_observations
functions.description: One GitHub Zen text response, retaining UTF-8 text and exact response bytes. Grain is one endpoint observation for the API host and current caller within an invocation; repeated invocations are snapshots, not historical records.

metrics.name: api_zen_observation_count
metrics.comment: Endpoint observations retrieved for the current caller; not a count of durable GitHub resources.

functions.name: api_octocat_observations
functions.description: One Octocat text rendering for the optional speech argument, retaining UTF-8 text and exact bytes. Grain is one endpoint observation for the API host and current caller within an invocation; repeated invocations are snapshots, not historical records.

arguments.name: octocat_speech
arguments.description: Optional text for the Octocat speech bubble; omission uses GitHub default text.

metrics.name: api_octocat_observation_count
metrics.comment: Endpoint observations retrieved for the current caller; not a count of durable GitHub resources.

functions.name: repository_license_files
functions.description: Repository-qualified license file snapshots, keyed by stable repository ID, returned path and immutable blob SHA. Returned license classification may be NULL; it is not equivalent to absence of a file. Default-branch or explicit-ref retrieval follows owner, organization, repository or repository cohort populations. Missing/inaccessible endpoint responses fail closed rather than claim zero coverage.

metrics.name: repository_license_file_count
metrics.comment: Selected repository license files, including files with no recognized catalog license classification.

repository_license_file_bytes.comment: Upstream file byte sizes for selected repository/path/blob snapshots; not the encoded string length.

routes.population: One detected license file for each selected repository/ref, with repository identity hydrated first. Missing/inaccessible file responses fail; a 404 is not silently counted as an unlicensed repository. Encoded content retains its declared encoding.

functions.name: repository_languages
functions.description: Canonical repository-qualified language byte statistics. Grain is repository ID plus the exact dictionary language name; values are GitHub language byte totals, not source-file counts or contributor ownership.

routes.name: repositories

arguments.name: owner
arguments.description: GitHub organization or user owner; user listings contain public owned repositories only. Mutually exclusive with repository and organization.

arguments.name: repository
arguments.description: One repository as owner/name. Mutually exclusive with owner and organization.

arguments.name: organization
arguments.description: Explicit GitHub organization scope. Mutually exclusive with owner and repository.

routes.population: All language entries from each selected repository, with full repository/owner/organization/cohort traversal. An empty dictionary emits zero language facts while repository context remains available.

metrics.name: repository_language_count
metrics.comment: Repository/language entries; the same language in two repositories counts twice.

repository_language_bytes.comment: GitHub reported language bytes over the selected repository/language entries.
